outline: 本課程旨在培養研究生具備參與國際性學術性會議或進行學術英文發表之能力，授課內容包括學習基本簡報技巧、加強簡報時所需要的英文語彙、搭配視聽器材進行實際演練活動等。
schedule:
WEEK	SESSION THEME
1	Introduction
2     	Giving a conference paper I
(You need to bring along a FIVE minute presentation that you have prepared, to deliver at this session. Plus an official ‘Call for Papers’ in your subject area.)
3     	Giving a conference paper II
4     	Giving a conference paper III
5    	From a written paper to an oral presentation I: Structure and visual aids
6    	From a written paper to an oral presentation II: Delivery and discussion
7    	From a written paper to an oral presentation III: Students
8    	Observing conference paper presentations (11/6-7)
9    	(No Mid-term)
Conference paper presentations (11/6-7): feedback and discussion
10   	Presentations and critiques I: Students
11   	Guest speaker
12   	Presentations and critiques II: Various speakers
13   	Presentations and critiques III: Students
14   	Presentations and critique IV: Students
15   	Wrap-up session
16   	Mock conference I (a 20 minute presentation and another 10 minute for Q&A)
17   	Mock conference II (a 20 minute presentation and another 10 minute for Q&A)
18    	Mock conference III (a 20 minute presentation and another 10 minute for Q&A)
assessment:
Assessment

	30% on the final Mock Conference (WK 16-18)
	70% on continual assessments: attendance to lectures; in-class presentations and participation; assignments
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】
